svg.aria-label: About, what I build, how it should feel, off the keyboard
svg.text: Hey, I'm Shahruk. I've been building for the web for about ten years, mostly for small businesses
in the US and UK: contractors, clinics, coaches and online stores. I write my own themes and
plugins instead of stacking page builders, so the sites stay fast and the code stays mine to fix.
know. The front end is Next.js,
and the Admin GraphQL API, for
My own product. It sits on a
Scroll that doesn't stutter. Headlines that land with some weight. Hover states someone actually
thought about. Most of that is GSAP and Lenis on top of a clean build, plus a lot of replaying the
same three seconds until the easing is right.
Fishing, travelling, and teaching WordPress and SEO on my YouTube channel, Learn With Shahruk.
